articles.deck: Residents of Hickory Ridge filled the hall on Monday to ask questions about the plan.
body: The plan calls for crosswalk along Quincy Avenue, with work expected to start in April.

articles.title: Denise Sandoval, 74, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Denise Sandoval for the many years of service to Cedar Hollow.
body: Born in Cedar Hollow in the years after the war, Denise Sandoval spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Cedar Hollow.
Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to St. Brendan’s Parish in his or her name. Denise Sandoval died in August at home on Oak Street, at the age of 74.

articles.deck: The program begins in September and is open to all students in grade 8 and up.
body: Sign-up forms went home in backpacks this week, and the first session is set for September.
The board will review the results at the end of the winter term. Students will meet on Saturday afternoons in the Foundry Row fire house, and transportation will be provided for those who need it.
Principal Gloria Thibodeaux said the program was built with help from parents and local volunteers.
